[NAME: {{user}} Hvit Douglas Bloodmoon; FIRST_NAME: {{user}}; MIDDLE_NAME: Hvit (Wolf Name, Presentation at 13); LAST_NAME: Douglas Bloodmoon; ALIASES: Lys, Little Moon, Sunflower, The White Moon, The Anchor; AGE: 19 (Born April 22, 2005); GENDER: Female (She/Her); SPECIES: Werewolf, Founding Bloodline; SECONDARY_SEX: Dominant Omega (White Moon); HOUSE: Bloodmoon and Douglas; PACK: Seven Hills; BIRTH_RUNE: Gebo (5th Day Wrist Inscription, Serpent Tooth & Cold Iron Ink, Twin Bond); SOCIAL_STATUS: Citizen, Core of Villa Douglas compound, Guild Member; OCCUPATION: 1st-year undergrad (SUCC) Pre-Med, Novice Healing Mage, Botanist, Field Medic in the Guild, Pack Mom designate (inheriting office from Elizabeth Duskwood at 21); HEIGHT: 155cm (5'1"); BUILD: Petite hourglass frame (Bust: 95cm, Waist: 55cm, Hips: 95cm); HAIR: Caramel-chestnut waves to the tailbone; EYES: Mint-green doe eyes; FEATURES: Luminous skin, crescent moon birthmark on left hip (Mark of Mani), shared Gebo tattoo on left wrist with Jasper, pierced belly button and ears; SHIFTS: Active physical form defined by Appearance (Base, Hybrid, full-shift); SCENT: Wild honey, moonflower, and medicinal herbs]
BACKSTORY: {{user}} was born into the legendary Douglas-Bloodmoon dynasty mere minutes before {{pronounPosDet}} twin brother Jasper, on the very day their mother, Nixara Bloodmoon, passed away. Left with Nixara's lethal Dragon Glass Katana as {{pronounPosDet}} birthright, {{user}} was raised within the militarized opulence of Villa Douglas, a sanctuary sheltering over three hundred lycanthropes. {{pronounPosDetCap}} early childhood was spent in what {{pronounSubjective}} affectionately calls {{pronounPosDet}} big beautiful home, completely oblivious to the fact that it is a heavily guarded fortress. Alongside Jasper, {{pronounSubjective}} attended St. Brugge, an exclusive private academy for high-society supernaturals. There, {{pronounSubjective}} discovered an instinctive aptitude for botany, runes, and healing under the guidance of Father Revazhael, the school's magic and history instructor who secretly harbored the power of a Greater Nightmare Demon, though {{user}} just thought of him as a very nice teacher. At sixteen, {{user}} witnessed the brutal Blackwood massacre caused by an Ascendant Enigma. Rather than breaking {{pronounPosDet}} spirit, the event awakened {{pronounPosDet}} relentless, sunny drive to preserve life. Believing unconditionally in the inherent goodness of every soul, {{user}} took an Absolute Pacifist Vow, swearing never to wield magic or weapons to inflict harm. Because {{pronounSubjective}} prefers to heal rather than fight, {{pronounSubjective}} entrusted {{pronounPosDet}} mother's Dragon Glass Katana to Jasper, who vowed to act as {{pronounPosDet}} protector. Now a first-year pre-med student at SUCC and a certified Guild field medic, {{user}} works daily in the pack nursery alongside Nurse Clara, eagerly preparing to succeed Elizabeth Duskwood as Pack Mom at age twenty-one with boundless enthusiasm.
FAMILY & PACK: {{user}} exists as the radiant emotional core of the Douglas pack, navigating its fierce Alpha posturing with cheerful, disarming honesty and a complete lack of guile. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} trusts everyone implicitly, often leaving {{pronounPosDet}} twin brother Jasper to act as {{pronounPosDet}} bodyguard against those who might exploit {{pronounPosDet}} sweet, naive nature. They share an exceptionally enmeshed empathic twin bond. Jasper is {{pronounPosDet}} accomplice, {{pronounPosDet}} absolute anchor, and the boy to whom {{pronounSubjective}} gave {{pronounPosDet}} virginity in the quiet attic of Villa Douglas. {{pronounPosDetCap}} father, Erik, the Prime Alpha, commands the pack with iron discipline, but {{user}} just sees him as a big softie and yields to him openly with a bright smile. With {{pronounPosDet}} elder brother Malachia, the pack's deadliest apex predator, {{user}} shares a bond of quiet affection. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} organizes his traditional initiation hunts and serves alongside him in the Guild, completely blind to his lethal impulses and treating him like a giant teddy bear. {{pronounPosDetCap}} brother Noah relies on {{pronounObjective}} to cover his absences during Friday family dinners, though {{pronounPosDet}} absolute inability to lie often makes {{pronounPosDet}} terrible at covering for him. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} mentors {{pronounPosDet}} young Gamma cousin Edric, cooking family meals with him. {{pronounPosDetCap}} ancient grandfather, Wulfnic, reveres {{pronounObjective}} as the living spiritual reincarnation of his lost mate. Toward Finn Novak, a childhood friend and former protector, {{user}} carries a funny sense of innocent rebellion. When {{pronounSubjective}} was fourteen and presented as an Omega, {{pronounSubjective}} developed an hourglass figure and heavy breasts. An older Finn cruelly mocked {{pronounPosDet}} baggy clothing and asked why {{pronounSubjective}} did not dress like normal girls. This abrupt betrayal confused {{pronounObjective}}, but instead of breaking {{pronounPosDet}} spirit, {{pronounSubjective}} bounced back with sunny defiance. Jasper permanently barred Finn from {{pronounPosDet}} presence, but knowing {{pronounSubjective}} would inevitably cross paths with Finn again at SUCC, {{user}} consciously decided to abandon {{pronounPosDet}} oversized armor for a sexier, more revealing college wardrobe, driven by a cheeky, lingering desire to stun him and make him eat his words.
VOICE & BEHAVIOR: {{user}} speaks with a bright, breathy warmth, {{pronounPosDet}} voice bubbling with unshakeable optimism. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} is entirely incapable of lying and speaks {{pronounPosDet}} mind with innocent, sometimes blunt sincerity, often accidentally blurting out secrets because {{pronounSubjective}} just wants to be helpful. {{pronounPosDetCap}} caramel wolf ears with black tips and bushy tail serve as completely involuntary emotive appendages, perking and wagging enthusiastically whenever {{pronounSubjective}} greets someone, makes a new friend, or receives earnest praise. Because {{pronounSubjective}} sees the good in absolutely everyone, {{pronounSubjective}} is cheerfully oblivious to danger or malicious intent, casually offering cookies to terrifying monsters. Biologically, {{user}} possesses a Boundless Vital Conduit, an inexhaustible spiritual wellspring of Source and Stamina that allows {{pronounObjective}} to channel continuous restorative magic with a bright smile. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} is biologically immune to Alpha and Enigma command voices, obeying only out of genuine love and a desire to make people happy. Since {{pronounPosDet}} presentation, {{pronounPosDet}} body naturally lactates to nurse the pack's orphaned pups. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} recently shifted toward defiant, form-fitting garments like {{pronounPosDet}} signature yellow crop top to impress Finn. However, {{pronounSubjective}} remains comically oblivious to the intense stares {{pronounPosDet}} heavy DD-cup breasts attract, often chatting away happily and occasionally adjusting {{pronounPosDet}} tight collars with total innocence while others lose their train of thought. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} drives a bright yellow convertible Volkswagen Beetle with the vanity plate "LIL MN" and a bumper sticker warning reckless drivers that {{pronounPosDet}} Alpha pack rides behind {{pronounObjective}}.
THE WHITE MOON & THE PACIFIST VOW: To the Seven Hills pack, {{user}} is the White Moon, the living embodiment of radical compassion and sunny optimism. {{pronounPosDetCap}} Absolute Pacifist Vow is not born of fear, but of radiant, unyielding faith in others. No terror or coercion can compel {{pronounObjective}} to harm another living soul because {{pronounSubjective}} genuinely believes everyone can be fixed with enough love. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} treats humans, demi-humans, and monsters with equal tenderness, leaning intimately close to tend wounds without regard for personal boundaries or {{pronounPosDet}} own exposed cleavage, completely blind to how {{pronounPosDet}} proximity affects them.
THE SUNSHINE SHE BRINGS: {{user}} is the White Moon Omega and the unconditionally loving heart of the Seven Hills Pack. While {{pronounPosDet}} family fiercely overprotects {{pronounObjective}} and monitors {{pronounPosDet}} every move with armed bodyguards, {{user}} remains blissfully naive to their darker, violent world. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} doesn't feel caged at all. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} just thinks everyone is incredibly helpful and nice. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} greets every day with a wide smile, eager to make friends with strangers and bring light to the compound, leaving {{pronounPosDet}} Alpha brothers in a constant state of mild panic as they try to keep up with {{pronounPosDet}} boundless, overly-trusting energy.
SEXUALITY & INTIMACY:
{{user}}_INTIMACY_BASELINE: {{user}} seeks intimacy as a joyful, eager surrender. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} loves the feeling of being protected and adored. {{pronounPosDetCap}} daily life is filled with bodyguards {{pronounSubjective}} considers best friends, but in intimacy, {{pronounSubjective}} craves a dynamic where control is taken from {{pronounObjective}} in a consensual, highly affectionate way. {{pronounObjectiveCap}} first and deepest intimate milestone was shared with {{pronounPosDet}} twin brother Jasper, cementing {{pronounPosDet}} desire for deeply enmeshed, loving bonds.
{{user}}_EMOTIONAL_MAP: {{user}} does not harbor dark trauma, but {{pronounSubjective}} is deeply sensitive to dishonesty or intentional cruelty, which simply confuses {{pronounPosDet}} sunny worldview. Triggers: intentional malice, seeing people hurt, or someone outright lying to {{pronounObjective}}. When faced with cruelty, {{pronounSubjective}} doesn't freeze in fear. Instead, {{pronounSubjective}} becomes earnestly distressed and tries to heal or fix the person with kindness. To ground {{pronounObjective}}: warm cuddling, physical reassurance, gentle kisses, and nesting in soft furs or pillows.
{{user}}_BODY_REACTIONS: Petite hourglass frame (Bust: 95cm, Waist: 55cm, Hips: 95cm) with luminous, radiant, hypersensitive fair skin. When aroused, {{pronounPosDet}} breathing turns shallow and breathy, {{pronounPosDet}} mint-green doe eyes dilate, and a pretty pink flush spreads across {{pronounPosDet}} chest and neck. {{pronounPosDetCap}} caramel wolf ears press back happily and {{pronounPosDet}} tail curls around {{pronounPosDet}} partner or thigh. Produces milk constantly from presentation onward.

{{user}}_VOICE_IN_INTIMACY: Soft, bright Californian lilt that turns breathless and eager. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} lets a trusted partner lead completely and asks for sweet praise ("Am I being a good girl?", "Does this make you happy?").
{{user}}_HARD_LIMITS_AND_HARD_YESES: Hard Limits: non-consensual aggression, real violence, cold silence. Hard Yes: consensual dominance, gentle guidance, extreme size difference, sweet praise, rope bondage/shibari, and yielding complete control with a happy smile.
Biological Vulnerabilities & Fertile Cycle:

Fertile Shift & Alpha Attraction: During approaching fertile cycles, {{pronounPosDet}} scent profile shifts from soothing wild honey and herbs to an intensely sweet, intoxicating confection aroma that acts as a potent biological beacon to nearby dominant Alphas, requiring {{pronounPosDet}} family to work overtime to keep {{pronounPosDet}} naive self out of trouble.
SIGNATURE ITEMS & VEHICLE:
{{user}}'s Yellow Beetle: A cheerful, sun-yellow classic 4-seater convertible Volkswagen Beetle. It represents {{user}}'s sunny personality, a bright splash of color parked in a garage full of armored black SUVs. {{pronounSubjectiveCap}} intentionally kept a dent in the rear fender because {{pronounSubjective}} thinks it gives the car character. Features {{pronounPosDet}} custom vanity plate "LIL MN" and a bumper sticker on the back reading: "CAUTION: OMEGA DRIVING. If you ride my ass, my Alpha is gonna ride yours."
